job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Architect to lead ... #Hir…

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless & PWA Commerce APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Architect
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in driving enterprise e-commerce architecture and platform scalability at Kavitha Kulandaivelu's organization. With over 5 years of hands-on backend and integration experience delivering complex enterprise commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in designing robust APIs, data pipelines, and scalable platform architectures.

bullets.label: Enterprise Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless & API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) for storefront and third-party consumers, engineering custom API migrations for customer account structures to improve system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: PIM/ERP Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels and investigated integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders and international technical teams, translating complex requirements into robust enterprise solutions while mentoring junior developers and conducting code reviews.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce and integration background aligns with your architectural goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering and integration expertise to Kavitha Kulandaivelu's team. My hands-on background building scalable backend services, headless APIs, and robust data pipelines for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell prepares me to contribute immediately to your architectural initiatives and complex platform implementations.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, headless API development, and PIM/ERP integration expertise to scale platform performance and drive technical excellence.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Kavitha, I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture and backend integration expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell. I'd love to connect and discuss how my platform engineering background aligns with your SFCC Architect needs.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Kulandaivelu,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Architect position. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, headless APIs, and complex integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your technical leadership team.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
